g.text: NPCI UPI Reconciliation – Agentic Automation Flow
End-to-End Orchestration: 4 Inbound Settlement Feeds → AutomationEdge Reconciler Agent → 3 Workflow Tools
Schema: RRN, TXN_ID, UTR, RAIL, CYCLE_ID, TXN_DATETIME, NPCI_AMOUNT, NPCI_STATUS
Role: Authoritative net settlement master ledger from NPCI clearing house.
Role: Customer account ledger debits, actual debit states & balances.
Role: Inter-bank settlement suspense balance & interim ledger (GL-14020).
Joins 50,000 records across NPCI, Switch, Finacle CBS, and
GL on unique RRN / UTR keys with sub-second execution.
Segregates STP matched transactions (zero variance) from
exception breaks (CBS timeouts, deemed fails & mismatches).
Dispatches segmented batches to 3 Process Studio execution
Automated accounting bot executing zero-delta journal entries for
all 4-way matched transactions straight through without touch.
✓ Action: Posts journal between GL-14020 (Suspense) & GL-11010 (Reserve)
✓ Result: Zero-delta ledger balance & instant settlement cycle closure
Autonomous customer refund bot executing straight-through credits for
low-value deemed failure breaks (customer debited, NPCI failed).
✓ Action: Calls Finacle CBS reversal API & credits customer account
✓ Result: 100% compliance with RBI T+1 TAT circular (stops penalty clock)
Agentic AI investigator synthesizing multi-leg evidence dossiers for
✓ Action: Compiles dossier & 94% confidence score for Ops Manager Cockpit
✓ Result: 1-click maker-checker sign-off with cryptographic audit seal
Integration Protocol: AutomationEdge Server REST Execution (POST /aeengine/rest/execute)
Architecture Pattern: Agent-to-Tools (Agentic Orchestrator → Specialized RPA Execution Bots)
Enterprise Solutions Consulting • Banking Operations Architecture
